prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: transparent standalone air-pump hose sprite for a romantic colored-pencil website.
Create ONE square PNG canvas, ideally 1024x1024, with a genuinely transparent RGBA alpha background (alpha=0 outside the hose), not white, not paper, not a baked checkerboard.
The sole subject is ONE slender charcoal/lavender rubber AIR PUMP HOSE. It runs diagonally from an open end at the bottom-left (x=5%, y=95%) in a gentle sideways S curve to an open end at upper-right (x=95%, y=5%). Entire hose is visible with both ends open and plainly cut; absolutely no connectors or fittings. The hose thickness is approximately 2% of the total canvas width, fairly consistent along its length. Softly shaded dark muted grey-lavender rubber, scratchy fine graphite pencil outlines and softly irregular hand-colored-pencil texture. Romantic pastel storybook illustration style, subtle shading, no glossy 3D or vector look.
No pump, no balloon, no basket, no connectors, no people, no bears, no text, no watermark, no other objects, no cast shadow. Only the narrow gently curving hose on true transparency.
